take: ANA announced it activated defenseman Pavel Mintyukov from injured reserve. He averaged 18.43 minutes over 10 games this season with two assists, and the Ducks controlled 42.83% of the quality of chances (expected goals) at five-on-five while he played, so the early returns are modest. ANA sits at 6-7-1 and has had the worse of the chances at 46.9%, so his return puts a second-pair, penalty-killing defenseman back in the lineup.
